name: VALIDA-HEM
description: A reproducible benchmark of reference-faithful summarization across nine local LLMs (4.4-9.3 GB) served by Ollama on an integrated Radeon 780M GPU (Vulkan). A fictional source text in Brazilian Portuguese with planted traps, a pre-registered rubric, and six runs per model (54 total), with all generated summaries, raw outputs and per-criterion evaluation.
